title: Nuclei, chromosomes and germ-plasm act only as seats of energy and centres of force

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Nuclei, chromosomes and germ-plasm act only as seats of energy and centres of force

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In development, variation and inheritance, material elements such as the spermatozoon, nucleus, chromosomes or germ-plasm never act as matter alone, but only as seats of energy and centres of force.

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: we must most carefully realise in the outset that the spermatozoon, the nucleus, the chromosomes or the germ-plasm can never _act_ as matter alone, but only as seats of energy and as centres of force.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci On Growth and Form claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: D’Arcy Wentworth Thompson, On Growth and Form (1st ed., Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1917), Chapter I, “Introductory”; topic “Morphology as dynamics”. Scope: embryology and heredity

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on thompson1917-ch01-09: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.20

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Developmental datasets document chromosome dynamics and energetics, yet all outcomes can be redescribed in the claim's terms. It therefore supplies no discriminating empirical criterion as stated.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: One could measure energy use and force generation during fertilization, chromosome motion and development, but the assertion that matter acts only as a seat of energy or centre of force has no distinct outcome from ordinary physical descriptions of matter.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The word only makes the framing metaphysical rather than a separable mechanism.

Seats of energy and centres of force lack unique modern measurements.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.2
data adequacy: 0.15
analysis feasibility: 0.25
data existence: 0.25
discriminating power: 0.15

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Applied to the nucleus, chromosomes, and germ-plasm, the sentence is a general thesis about dynamics rather than a prediction about inheritance. Existing developmental and genomic data describe material causes in detail, but both the claim and its rivals survive that description. It is not resolvable by analysis of those data.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The wording says hereditary material never acts as matter alone but only as a seat of energy and a centre of force. Molecular and embryological measurements can be redescribed in those words, so they do not yield a distinct confirming or refuting result.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Sequence-specific effects in development are compatible with the claim under a change of vocabulary.

The contrast between matter acting alone and matter as a centre of force is not an empirical contrast.
